about: module clientgen's mutants (wf10 GEN-MODEL): each is judged by the module's laws (scripts/examples -modules clientgen). The law that kills each is named in its rule.

mutants.name: smithy-trait-dropped
mutants.from:
if has(knownTraits, m.Key) {
			out = out.Append(Known{Id: m.Key, Value: m.Value})
mutants.rule: No trait is dropped: each is read as Known or kept as Refused, by name: EveryTraitReadOrRefused.

mutants.name: smithy-prune-drops-error
mutants.rule: Prune keeps an operation's error shapes and what they reach: PruneKeepsClosure.

mutants.name: smithy-prune-drops-map-value
mutants.rule: Prune keeps a map's value target: PruneKeepsClosure; the member list also feeds WriteReadRoundTrips through Refusals' walk.

mutants.name: smithy-drop-misses-member
mutants.from: Member{Name: m.Name, Target: m.Target, Traits: strippedTraits(m.Traits, drop)}
mutants.rule: A dropped trait appears nowhere in the slice, members included: PruneKeepsClosure (drawn members carry the droppable traits).

mutants.name: emit-member-dropped
mutants.from: out = out.Append(try fieldOf(index, m, op, input))
mutants.rule: Each output member is read from exactly one place: EveryMemberIsBound (drawn outputs hold several members).

mutants.name: emit-optional-required
mutants.from: if f.Required { base } else { optionName + "[" + base + "]" }
mutants.rule: A required member that is not a label is written as its type, not an Option: the test RequiredIsPlain.

mutants.name: emit-label-never-greedy
mutants.rule: A {Key+} label is planned greedy: the test GreedyLabelIsGreedy, and the drift case examples/clientgen/cases/s3-current (the committed s3.ergo writes aws.Label(r.Key, true)); its effect on the client is modules/aws's emit-label-not-greedy, killed by SlashesStayInThePath.

mutants.name: emit-put-uses-wrong-helper
mutants.rule: Optional int fields must emit PutInt rather than PutText: CleanEmissionShapes verifies emitted PutInt calls.

mutants.name: emit-enum-decode-drops-map
mutants.rule: Output enum headers decode via Option.Map(<enum>Of) rather than removed <enum>In wrappers: CleanEmissionShapes catches reverting to <enum>In.

mutants.name: emit-same-outcome-not-checked
mutants.from: "\t\t\(rt).SameOutcome(func() \(op.Output) { try \(call) }, func(a, b) { a == b }, func(a, b) { a == b })",
mutants.to: "\t\t\(rt).SameOutcome(func() \(op.Output) { try \(call) }, func(a, b) { a == a && b == b }, func(a, b) { a == b })",
mutants.rule: Generated repeatable/idempotent laws must compare outcomes with a == b inside SameOutcome: CleanEmissionShapes verifies the emitted SameOutcome law.

mutants.name: emit-enum-wire-omitted
mutants.rule: Enums used on input must emit <enum>Wire: CleanEmissionShapes verifies func tierInWire is emitted.
